verdict.rationale: Proa emits server-rendered HTML, so the browser receives real markup. Interactive islands ship as small vanilla-JS modules on a ~1.3 KB runtime, and some components ship CSS-only or as server-drawn SVG, which implies inspectable native DOM rather than an opaque rendering layer. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses debugging in browser devtools or confirms that island updates manipulate the real DOM directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of devtools debugging workflow, confirmation that client-side island reactivity patches real DOM nodes without a virtual DOM, independent/hands-on corroboration.
